note: Capitec's 2026 personal banking fees: the main account's monthly administration fee is 7.50 rand, with a minimum balance of 30 rand kept. Read again 2026-10-30: a payment to another South African bank by app 2.00 rand (immediate 6.00); an international payment 175.00; a cash withdrawal at any South African ATM 10.00 rand per 1,000 withdrawn (a charge on the amount, which the form's home ATM figures don't hold, so none is written); at an international Mastercard ATM 70.00; a debit order returned for insufficient funds 6.00; purchases at international card machines are free of a Capitec fee (no share on another currency is stated). Not stated: overdraft, interest, what opening asks.
